newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Two Americans arrested in Brazil meteorite theft.
newsitem.headline: Two Americans arrested in Brazil meteorite theft.

text.p: Two Americans have been arrested for allegedly stealing three meteorite fragments from Rio de Janeiro's National Museum, the curator said on Monday.

Curator Maria Elizabeth Zucolotto said police arrested Frederick Marcelli, 67, and Ronald Farrell, 43, on Friday at Rio de Janeiro airport after finding the meteor fragments inside a shoe in their luggage. The two were on their way to Sao Paulo to catch an airplane to New York.

"The two men visited the museum saying they were dealers in meteorites but they made me suspicious because they are not known in the scientific world nor could I find them listed anywhere as dealers," Zucolotto said. "After they left I checked the meteorites and noticed the theft. They had changed them for similar looking ones."
A police spokesman said the two were being held in police custody and the meteorites had been returned to the museum.
